overview: Dee Jay is a pressure-oriented rushdown character with many ways to set up frame traps or other mixups. His playstyle heavily revolves around feinting, wherein Dee Jay looks like he is approaching or performing a move before ducking away and returning to neutral. Efficient use of feints, his strong pressure buttons, and his excellent Drive Rush can let Dee Jay dance all over the screen like it's nothing.

Jus Cool is Dee Jay's primary tool setting up his pressure, and is a very unique special move. Most comparable to Slayer's "Dandy Step" from the Guilty Gear franchise, Jus Cool sways Dee Jay back and allows him to follow up with five unique follow-ups. Jus Cool can be followed up with a low kick that frame traps, an overhead kick that is safe and knocks down on hit, a launching knee swing for anti-airs, and a forwards dash that can be canceled out of with a second sway back. Utilizing all of these follow-ups can be somewhat tricky, but thankfully Dee Jay has numerous excellent pressure normals to help him along. His 5MP is plus, his 6MK is a plus normal that catches jump-outs, and his j.2K allows him to reset pressure with a jump-in attack must faster than other characters. Combining Jus Cool with his close range pressure options allows Dee Jay to mix opponents regardless of where he is on the screen, making him a devastating dance partner to be duking it out with.

Dee Jay's special move selection is rounded out by Air Slasher, a charge fireball that can be used to counter-zone, Jackknife Maximum for anti-airing, and Rolling Sobat to cover ground and either stagger or knock the opponent down. The most notable trait of these three moves, which winds up tying back into his trickiness, is that their light versions are all feints, which allows Dee Jay to bait people into responding for whiff punishes or reset pressure if he is close. To this end, Dee Jay has a lot of very fast movement options; his forward dash and particularly his Drive Rush are incredibly quick, which pairs well with his many lengthy pokes. If Dee Jay manages to get a good hit his damage potential becomes extremely high, as his OD moves all deal incredible damage and his Machine Gun Upper special is one of the highest damage combo enders in the game.

Dee Jay's up close pressure and screen control is very strong, but comes with somewhat of an awkward kit to work with. None of Dee Jay's longer reaching normals are special cancelable, making it difficult for him to meaningfully follow up with pokes. As well, all of his cancelable buttons are stubby, which can result in him dropping combos if the spacing isn't perfect. Armored moves, particularly Drive Impacts, will break right through his longer buttons if he doesn't use them carefully. Additionally, because his primary reversal is Overdrive Jackknife Maximum and he uses a lot of Drive for conversions, Dee Jay generally has a hard time in Burnout. Thus, Dee Jay can be a surprisingly demanding character at high levels of play. While all of the above can make Dee Jay somewhat awkward to play, putting time into using him effectively will carry you very far. If you enjoy cool beats and slick dance moves, do the dancehall ting with Dee Jay.

pick.title: Nimble Movement
pick.text: Tricky movements, including a fast forward dash, Drive Rush and sway specials to close the distance and whiff punish.

pick.title: Feints
pick.text: Using feint special moves to bait opponents to respond incorrectly.

pick.title: Massive Damage
pick.text: Cashing out resources to convert hits or approaches into big damage.

avoid.title: Abnormal Normals
avoid.text: Committal pokes without cancel windows that can get stuffed with a Drive Impact if used carelessly.

avoid.title: Picky Combos
avoid.text: Short cancelable buttons that are prone to drop if spaced wrong.

avoid.title: Drive-Hungry
avoid.text: Spending lots of Drive for conversions and not having a proper invincible Level 1 for a reversal in Burnout.

moves.name: Weekend Pleasure (CA)

moves.name: Machine Gun Uppercut
moves.notes: Damage Distribution: 100x4,150x4,100x4,180x3,260; () refers to damage on high juggle (puts opponent into limited juggle state, and can potentially link SA3 for huge damage); combo/juggle tool; requires CH/PC/DR 5HP or 4HK(1st) to combo on the ground; doesn't play out full animation on block or on high juggle connect; cancels on 1st or 13th hit; Punish Counter Drive dmg refers to before and after Super cancelable hit; good anti-air hitbox but cannot hit cross-up and is too slow for practical AA purposes

moves.name: Jus Cool
moves.notes: Can input follow-ups on frames 13-25 (variable timing allows stronger mixups and reaction to opponent's response); useful shimmy tool that can be canceled into to bait the opponent's defensive button press; Distance: 0.602 back

moves.name: Jus Cool
moves.notes: 1f extra recovery on block; can input attack follow-ups on frames 25-37 (frames 13-25 of the sway itself), and can input 6P dash follow-up after frame 19; puts opponent into limited juggle state; attack follow-ups can be input 3f earlier on block, allowing for 4f frame trap with LK follow-up; Distance: 0.74 back

moves.name: Juggling Dash
moves.notes: Can be input after 19f of 214KK (startup refers to this pre-dash period); hit/block adv. refers to data after 214KK attack connects (fastest timing); can cancel into 4P backdash on frames 18-23 of dash; can low profile under many high attacks while dashing; after 214KK launch, can dash to switch sides and follow up with a juggled [2]8K or SA1; Distance: 2.0 forward

moves.name: Juggling Sway
moves.notes: Hit/block advantage refers to data after 214KK attack connects (fastest timing); only 1f faster than letting 6P dash finish and ending with regular backdash; Distance: 1.0 back; can follow up with OD Jus Cool LK / MK / HK follow-ups (but not another Juggling Dash)

moves.name: Maximum Strike
moves.notes: Puts the opponent into limited juggle state (free juggle state on grounded Punish Counter; requires initial 214KK to whiff); the upper hitbox whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox (can only hit crouchers at very close range); can work as an anti-air if opponent jumps during Sway startup, and can hit cross-up

moves.name: Funky Slicer
moves.notes: Safe low ender; 5f extra recovery on whiff or vs. armor; good for whiff punishing after baiting opponent with 214KK; earliest timing on block gives 4f gap that can set up trade combos into 5HP

moves.name: Waning Moon
moves.notes: Safe overhead ender that can lead to follow-up combos on hit; 12-22f low crush (not airborne); first 2 active frames can only hit airborne; +7 on hit vs. standing; +6 on hit vs. all crouching characters (most likely scenario due to being an overhead); causes OTG bounce vs. airborne opponents (can juggle into any Super, OD Jackknife, or MK/HK Sobat); Punish Counter vs. airborne gives a more lenient juggle state on ground bounce

moves.name: Juggling Dash
moves.notes: Startup refers to fastest 214K animation before 6P can be input, recovery refers to 6P dash animation; cancelable into 4P backdash on frames 18-23 of dash; can low profile under many high attacks while dashing; Distance: 2.36 forward

moves.name: Maximum Strike

moves.name: Funky Slicer

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick

moves.name: Crouching Medium Punch

moves.name: Air Slasher

moves.name: Air Slasher

moves.name: Air Slasher

moves.name: Threebeat Combo 2

moves.name: Dee Jay Special 2

moves.name: Funky Dance 1

moves.notes: Causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents

moves.name: Diss Track
moves.notes: Allows corner throw loop by walking or dashing; dash + whiff 5LP sets up +3 situation; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.763 (min/throw), 2.535 (min/block), 2.713 (max/final DR frame)

patches.summary: Alex Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: 2LK projectile invincibility added to the hurtbox above Dee Jay's foot
2MP hitstun 22 → 23; Hit Advantage +4 → +5; DRC Hit Advantage +12 → +13
Now links to 5LK and combos when canceled into MP Machine Gun Uppercut (214MP); DR~2MP links to 5HP on crouching opponents
Whiff recovery increased 14 → 15; extended hurtbox lasts until the end of recovery
2HP expanded the front hurtbox during recovery
HP Machine Gun Uppercut (214HP) Super Gain on hit increased 2100 → 2500 and increased the input buffer at the end of recovery
OD Machine Gun Uppercut (214PP) startup reduced 28 → 26; can now combo from 5HP or 4HK (1st hit) as well as PC/DR 2MP
OD Waning Moon (214KK~MK) no longer hits standing opponents on the first active frame (gives consistent +6 advantage on tall characters)
Juggling Sway (214K/KK~6P~4P) can now cancel the backdash into ~LK / ~MK / ~HK follow-ups for more mixup potential
Reduced the forward hurtbox on frames 5-17 (normal) / 5-13 (OD); moves backward earlier on the OD version

patches.summary: C. Viper Release. Minor bug fixes and adjustments for some characters.
notes: OD Waning Moon (214KK~MK) expanded the collision box upward on frames 16-19
Primarily intended to fix issue with Modern controls Assist Combo 3 whiffing under opponents

patches.summary: Elena Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: Modern Controls:
Jackknife Maximum ([2]8K / [2]S) shortcut switched from M version → H version
SA2 can now use the M/H versions by holding Back or Forward during screen freeze after 236236M input
Can also use cinematic enders with 6H/4H
2LK
Reduced pushback on hit/block for chain combo consistency
5HP
Reduced pushback on hit from active frame 3 onward (gives more consistent follow-ups when spaced)
MK Jackknife Maximum ([2]8MK)
2nd hit knocks airborne opponents farther away
HK Jackknife Maximum ([2]8HK)
Startup reduced 6 → 5
Combo-only hitbox extended forward for easier links and juggles
OD Jackknife Maximum ([2]8KK)
1st hit combo-only hitbox expanded forward for consistency
OD Jus Cool (214KK)
Blockstun increased 20 → 24
Block Advantage increased -22 → -18
Now a true blockstring into Funky Slicer (~6LK) at earliest cancel timing
Combo-only hitbox expanded forward for consistency
Threebeat Combo (5LP~MK~MK)
Second attack can now come out while holding a downward direction

patches.summary: Minor balance changes for all characters.
notes: Knee Shot (j.2LK)
Drive Gain increased 500 → 2000
Funky Dance Feint (5MP~5MP~4HP)
Total Recovery decreased 23 → 22
Hit Advantage increased -4 → -3
Block Advantage increased -6 → -5
Dee Jay is now safe from 4-frame normals on hit and 6f reversals on block, making the mixup more effective
MK Jackknife Maximum ([2]8MK)
Active frames increased 3(10)4 → 4(9)4 (no change to total duration)
HK Jackknife Maximum ([2]8HK)
Active frames increased 4(8)5(8)4 → 5(7)5(8)4 (no change to total duration)
Extended the air-only hitbox upward, making it a more consistent anti-air
Waning Moon (214K~MK)
Punish Counter causes a longer ground bounce time
Now guarantees a 236HK juggle if 2nd active frame connects (always occurs vs. crouching)
OD Waning Moon (214KK~MK)
Juggle Start/Increase reduced 14 → 4
Much more lenient juggles after ground bounce, including OD Jackknife and MK/HK Sobat

patches.summary: Terry Release. Minor balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Face Breaker (4HK)
Collision box changed to make OD Jus Cool juggles more consistent (specials should no longer come out in the wrong direction)
Threebeat Combo 1 (5LP~MK)
Reduced pushback on hit (keeps Dee Jay closer for the 3rd hit of the Target Combo for a strike/throw mixup)
Recovery increased 18 → 20
Hitstun increased 23 → 25 and Blockstun increased 18 → 20 (no change to overall advantage)
Hitconfirm window is 2f more lenient, making it possible to confirm a successful MK after blocked 5LP
Now applies 20% Starter scaling (e.g. blocked 5LP that frame traps into MK)
No longer forces stand on hit
Threebeat Combo 2 (5LP~MK~MK)
Recovery decreased 21 → 19
Hitstun decreased 27 → 25 and Blockstun decreased 16 → 14 (no change to overall advantage)
Hitstop increased 9 → 11 (keeps the timing consistent for both players after the final hit despite the hitstun/blockstun changes)
Drive Impact
Fixed issue where the proximity guard hitbox did not match the full attack hitbox range
Fixed issue where absorbing an attack caused the attack hitbox range to be shorter than usual
Jackknife Maximum ([2]8K)
Initial hitbox expanded downward for consistency against moves with low-profile landing recovery (e.g. Juri's j.214K)
Waning Moon (214K~MK)
Drive Damage on Block increased 4000 → 6000
Punish Counter now causes a ground bounce
30% Starter scaling applied
OD Waning Moon (214KK~MK)
Now causes ground bounce vs. airborne opponents (can juggle into Supers)
Juggle Limit increased 13 → 19
Now causes a sliding Hard Knockdown vs. airborne opponents

patches.summary: M. Bison Release. Minor balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Threebeat Combo 1 (5LP~MK)
2nd hit can no longer be performed when inputting both MP+MK (to prevent accidental TC when attempting a DR Cancel)
MK/HK Jackknife Maximum ([2]8MK/HK)
Now throw invuln on frames 5-6

patches.summary: Akuma Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: 2MK extends a hurtbox on whiff until end of recovery
5HP starter scaling 20% added
2HK has more consistent juggle state after anti-air Punish Counter
Face Breaker (4HK) 1st hit juggles opponent much lower (requires 2-hit version for most follow-up juggles, which uses up more juggle potential)
Knee Shot (j.2LK) reduced vertical hitbox; now in a Punish Counter state until landing (more risky vs. specific anti-air normals)
Threebeat Combo (5LP~MK~MK) Hit Advantage +2 → +3
OD Air Slasher ([4]6PP) starter scaling 20% added; more juggle potential on 2nd hit
Jackknife Maximum ([2]8MK/HK/KK) airborne 1f later (4f → 5f); reduced forward hitbox vs. grounded opponents (weaker as a punish)
Double Rolling Sobat (236HK) improved juggle limit
OD Double Rolling Sobat (236KK) improved juggle limit and less likely to whiff under opponent
Funky Slicer (214K~LK) starter scaling 20% added; 3f extra recovery on whiff or vs. armor; more susceptible to low-crush attacks
Maximum Strike (214K~HK) anti-air invuln now applies to body on frames 15-19
OD Maximum Strike (214KK~HK) now counts as 2 hits of scaling when comboed into
SA1 damage 1800 → 2000, recovery 45 → 33, Block Advantage -24 → -12 with more pushback
SA2 now scales Super Art meter gain by 30% for all hits until the combo ends

patches.summary: Ed Release. Several balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Funky Slicer (214K~LK)
Less pushback on block
Larger hurtbox during recovery (easier to pressure Dee Jay or whiff punish)
Speedy Maracas (22PP)
Fixed issue where plinking the button input (e.g. 22P~P) caused the move to be recognized as a canceled activation even while holding the buttons
Fixed issue where the move would not end upon button release with under 1 bar of Super gauge
Modern Controls: fixed issue where the move could not be performed when plinking the buttons as 22M~H
Modern Controls: fixed issue where a different button was required to continue the Held version depending on the amount of Super gauge stocked

patches.summary: A.K.I. Release. Bug fixes with some minor changes due to bugs
notes: Modern Controls
Air Slasher shortcut ([4]S) will now only come out while still holding Back (4) or Up-Back (7)
The short period where charge time is retained after letting go of the backward input no longer applies except when manually inputting Air Slasher
This prevents overlap issues with Rolling Sobat and Jus Cool, as the Air Slasher would take priority for a short while after releasing charge
Assist Combo 1
Fixed issue where Dee Jay could not perform 5LK > 236MK by inputting it as A[L] > 6S
Assist Combo 3
Fixed issue where the 3rd hit of the combo would have extra damage scaling if input late
Speedy Maracas (22P)
Now in a Punish Counter state when transitioned into from Air Slasher (to avoid confusion when punishing the projectile)
Can no longer transition from Air Slasher into Speedy Maracas when the projectile hits as a Counter-hit/Punish Counter, is parried, or is absorbed by armor
Drive Reversal
Updated the hurtbox to match the visuals more closely
Universal Adjustments - Attacks Hitting Behind
5LK, 214P (1st hit), SA2, SA3
Universal Adjustments - Chip Damage vs. Burnout
Universal Adjustments - Drive Gain vs. Burnout
214K/KK~LK, 214K/KK~MK,
Universal Adjustments - Perfect Parry Drive Gain
4HK, 236HK, 236KK, SA2 (M/H versions)

patches.summary: Rashid Release. Bug fixes with some minor balance changes mainly for Modern controls.
notes: Face Breaker (4HK)
Fixed issue where Punish Counter Drive Damage was higher vs. airborne opponents
Back Throw (4LPLK)
Fixed issue where Punish Counter built the same amount of Super gauge is a standard throw
